set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add make_null_fun_glm() / permutation_glm(method='freedman_lane') for raw subject contrast images with formulas or design matrices, named contrasts or contrast vectors, nuisance covariates, and deterministic residual permutations. Document as preferred for unbalanced clinical/control comparisons. Roadmap heteroskedasticity-robust residual resampling. Tests: small GLM contrasts match lm(), deterministic nulls, reduced/full design validation.
set.title: Scale-space: GLM Freedman-Lane null generator
